initScript: setInterval(function(){ try { var e=window.__experience; if(e&&e.revealMesh){ e.revealMesh.visible=false; } } catch(err){} }, 50);

steps.label: wuMat
steps.js: (function(){ try { var e=window.__experience; var wu=window.__labWuMesh; if(!wu) return "no-wu"; var cam=e.engine.camera.instance; var p=wu.position.clone(); p.project(cam); var m=wu.material; var u=m&&m.uniforms; var tex=u&&u.uMap&&u.uMap.value; return JSON.stringify({vis:wu.visible, screen:[Math.round((p.x*0.5+0.5)*1280),Math.round((-p.y*0.5+0.5)*720)], ndcZ:+p.z.toFixed(3), hasMat:!!m, matType:m&&m.type, hasTex:!!tex, texImg:!!(tex&&tex.image), texW:tex&&tex.image&&tex.image.naturalWidth, uHasTex:u&&u.uHasTex&&u.uHasTex.value, scale:[+wu.scale.x.toFixed(2),+wu.scale.y.toFixed(2)], ro:wu.renderOrder, depthTest:m&&m.depthTest}); } catch(err){ return String(err); } })()
